BillHeading.Sponsors: Representatives Leavitt, Jacobsen, Pollet, Reeves, and Bronoske

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Postsecondary Education & Workforce.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to applied doctorate degree-granting authority; adding a new section to chapter 28B.35 RCW; and repealing RCW 28B.35.215, 28B.35.216, and 28B.35.218.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 28B.35 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The board of trustees of the regional universities may offer applied, but not research, doctorate level degrees.

BillSectionHeader.P: The following acts or parts of acts are each repealed:

BillSection.P: 1RCW 28B.35.215 (Doctorate level degrees in physical therapy) and 2012 c 229 s 812 & 2001 c 252 s 1;
2RCW 28B.35.216 (Doctorate level degrees in audiology) and 2013 c 281 s 1; and
3RCW 28B.35.218 (Doctorate level degrees in education) and 2020 c 15 s 1.
